Open Fire cooking in the Texas Hill Country ASMR:  This Picahna w/ Roasted Salsa Criolla was💰 A well-marbled picanha is arguably the best steak on the planet, in my opinion. It honestly doesn’t need a thing. But if you’re gonna pair it with a salad, this Salsa Criolla is the move. Originating from Argentina, it’s a fresh,l and a cross between chimichurri and salsa. Ofcoarse I added a little twist to it. The salsa (Salad if you’re healthy) cuts through the richness of the beef perfectly. I got this idea from one of my best friends, @Al Frugoni He made it for my family when we moved to Texas and cooked our first asado on our property. One of those meals I’ll never forget. 🔥 Ingredients: 🔥 1 whole garlic bulb 🔥 2 jalapeños 🔥 6-8 mini peppers 🔥 1 large white onion 🔥 red wine vinegar 🔥 olive oil @getgraza  🔥 @alfrugonishop TX.SP 🔥 @tftibbqshop Cajun Honey Rub Spicy Garlicky * Measure with your heart❤️‍🔥 Meat: @High Society Meats Australian Wagyu Picanha Salt: @alfrugonishop Grilling Salt Charcoal: @Jealous Devil  Wood: Oak Grill: @Tagwoodbbq  Knife: @Montana Knife Co The Montana folding knife Prep Tub: @DRIP EZ  Food Storage Container: @bbq_dripez Secondz 🐕: Roxy Living in the Texas Hill Country is such a vibe compared to the Bay Area, California. No sounds of traffic, planes, or city noise. Just the wind, the wildlife, and every now and then… my pool cleaner. 😫 This has been a dream of ours for a long time, and we couldn’t be happier. We made the move most only talk about. California will always be home, but Texas is where we’re building our family’s future. Feeling truly blessed. A spoonful of chili oil and seafood make everything hotter and better.🔥 Shrimp heads, soft tofu, crab, octopus, and juicy shrimp simmer into a rich, spicy broth that’s guaranteed to bring you back to life❤️‍🔥 Would you try this after a night out?🍜✨ 📍 Tag your late-night buddy & save this recipe for your next rough morning ✨ Hailey’s Hangover Seafood Tofu Ramen 📝 Ingredients * 2–3 tbsp chili oil * 2 eggs * 1 green onion, chopped * 2–3 cloves garlic, sliced * 1 pack Shin Ramyun (soup base + veggie packet) * 2 cups water * 3–5 large shrimp (heads separated) * 1 small crab * Baby octopus * Soft tofu * Rice cakes * A handful of bok choy (or bean sprouts) * Fresh red chili, sliced 👩‍🍳 Instructions 1. Heat the chili oil over medium heat. Crack in one egg and let the edges crisp slightly. 2. Add the shrimp heads, crab, baby octopus, garlic, and green onion. Sauté for about 1 minute until fragrant. 3. Remove the egg and octopus so they don’t overcook. 4. Stir in the Shin Ramyun soup base and veggie packet, then pour in the water. Bring to a boil. 5. Add the noodles, soft tofu, rice cakes, and shrimp. Cover and cook for about 2 minutes. 6. Return the octopus and add the bok choy. Cook just until the shrimp turn pink and the bok choy is tender-crisp. 7. Top with the crispy egg, an extra egg yolk (optional), and fresh red chili. Enjoy immediately. 💡 Tip: Add a splash of soy sauce if the broth needs a little more seasoning.  #asmrfood #mukbang #ramenhacks #hangovercure #fyp

thick bakery style chocolate chip cookies🍪🍫 Ingredients: 170g (3/4 cup) unsalted butter, cold and cubed 150g (3/4 cup) brown sugar 70g (1/3 cup) granulated sugar 1 egg + 1 egg yolk 2 tsp vanilla 300g (2 1/2 cups) all purpose flour 1 tbsp cornstarch 1/2 tsp baking soda 1/4 tsp baking powder 3/4 tsp salt 250g (1 1/2 cups) chocolate chips  Flakey sea salt (optional) Instructions:  1. In a large bowl, combine the butter, brown sugar, and white sugar. Mix until smooth and well combined. Do not cream. 2. Add the egg, egg yolk, and vanilla, then mix until fully incorporated. 3. Add the dry ingredients (flour, cornstarch, baking powder, baking soda, and salt) and fold until just combined. 4. Fold in the chocolate chips or chunks until evenly distributed. Do not overmix. 5. Divide the dough into 150g portions and shape each into a rough ball. 6. Place the dough balls on a lined tray, cover, and refrigerate for at least 1 hour or overnight. 7. Bake in a preheated 190°C (375°F) oven for 13-16 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown and the centers are still slightly soft. 8. Allow the cookies to cool on the baking tray for a few minutes, then transfer to a wire rack. If desired, sprinkle with flaky sea salt and let cool for about 15 minutes before serving. Enjoy! Note: This recipe made 6 cookies weighing 150g each and 1 cookie weighing 100g🍪🤎 #baking #cookies #chocolatechipcookies #Recipe #nyccookies

Cottage food laws in Kentucky allow me to sell up to $60,000/year in baked goods from home. Most states have cottage food laws like this, some stricter, but a lot have laws that allow for even more sales sometimes without sales cap at all. In Kentucky, it is as simple as filling out an application and paying a $50 fee to the health department to get a license.👩‍🍳  I started my cottage bakery after having our first baby. I have always loved working with my hands and wanted to bring a piece of home to my community. I also loved the idea of being able to be home with my family and make money doing something I love. Being able to bake and sell food from home has been the biggest blessing for our family. Pt.4 | My fall bakery menu 🍂 Recipe below 👇🏼  Crumbl released their Dubai Chocolate Brownie, but why buy it when you can make an even better one at home? 🤎✨ Ingredients 🟤Brownie Base * 180g caster sugar * 2 eggs * 113g unsalted butter (for browning) * 170g chopped chocolate * 80g plain flour * 3 tbsp cocoa powder * ½ tsp salt 💚Kunafa Filling * 260g kunafa pastry (finely chopped) * 2 tbsp unsalted butter (for toasting kunafa) * 320g pistachio cream 🍫Chocolate Ganache * 120g double cream * 100g milk chocolate (chopped) Instructions 1. Preheat the oven to 170°C and line a baking pan with parchment paper. 2. Brown 113g of unsalted butter in a saucepan until golden, then set aside. 3. Melt the chopped chocolate in the microwave in short bursts until smooth, then stir in the browned butter and let cool slightly. 4. In a separate bowl, whisk the sugar and eggs until light and fluffy. 5. Add the chocolate butter mixture to the eggs and sugar, and whisk until fully combined. 6. Fold in the flour, cocoa powder, and salt until just incorporated. 7. Pour all of the brownie batter into the prepared pan, smooth the top, and bake for 22 minutes. Let cool completely in the pan. 8. In a pan over medium heat, melt 2 tbsp of butter. Add the finely chopped kunafa pastry and cook, stirring often, until golden and crisp. Let cool slightly. 9. Mix the toasted kunafa pastry with the pistachio cream until fully combined, then spread evenly over the cooled brownie. 10. Place the pan in the fridge for about 30 minutes to set. 11. For the ganache, place the double cream and chopped milk chocolate in a microwave-safe bowl. Heat in short bursts, stirring in between, until melted and glossy. 12. Pour the ganache over the pistachio-kunafa layer, spread evenly, and refrigerate, ideally overnight, or at least 1 hour before slicing. Enjoy! 🤎 #baking #dubaichocolate #brownies #Recipe #fall
